nifty_filter: Reject only when both completed slot and session directions oppose the trade
vix_filter: Reject LONG when session and recent VIX changes are both >= 2%; reject SHORT when both are <= -2%
early_session_fallback: Use the session VIX change when a full 30-minute lookback is unavailable, matching the tested candidate
selection_basis: Explicit user adoption on 2026-10-23 after reviewing 5-minute versus 30-minute results
